title: Files tab — where the switch lives

steps.headline: The switch already uses the same background as the tabs — the odd one out is the search box.

options.label: Leave the search box alone (recommended)
options.summary: Measured: the tabs pill and the new switch are both srgb(22,27,34) in Midnight — the exact same colour, from the same style. The search box is srgb(33,38,45), a lighter shade, and it has been that way since long before this work. Leaving it means one row with two shades on it, which is what you have today.

options.label: Make the search box match the pills too
options.summary: The whole row would settle to one shade. But this same search box is used in the session drawer as well, so it would change colour in both places, and it is the box you type into — a darker field is slightly less obviously a text box than a lighter one.

steps.headline: Where should the switch sit — on the toolbar, or small on the 'Project Files' line?

variants.label: A — on the toolbar
variants.summary: What you reviewed a moment ago. A filled pill next to the search box, matching the tabs beside it. Easiest to spot and biggest to hit, but it is a fourth thing on an already busy row, and it takes about 60 pixels from the search box at every width.

variants.label: B — small, on the 'Project Files' line
variants.summary: Two small icons at the right end of the line under the toolbar, with no pill behind them. The toolbar row goes back to exactly what it is today and the search box keeps its full width, including on a phone. The switch is quieter and further from your eye, and it now sits on a line that is otherwise about where you are, not what you are doing.

steps.headline: The same choice at phone width, where the row is tightest.

variants.label: A — on the toolbar
variants.summary: The switch shares the row with search and '+ Add file'. Everything fits on one line, but the search box is squeezed and its placeholder clips to 'Search fil…'.

variants.label: B — small, on the 'Project Files' line
variants.summary: The search box goes back to its full width and reads 'Search files…' again. The switch drops to the line below, at the right edge, where it is small enough that it may be easy to miss on a phone.
